# @kirana-ui/react

> Kirana UI Primitives for React: headless, accessible components with no styles of their own. The same components, parts, attributes and behaviour as on the other four frameworks, from one core.

Generated from the library's own definitions (`bun scripts/llms.ts`): what is here is what the components do.

## Using it

- Each component is a namespace of parts: `<Dialog.Root>`, `<Dialog.Trigger>`. A component with one part is the component: `<Button>`.
- A part renders its own element and takes that element's props. `render` draws another element or component in its place: `<Dialog.Trigger render={<a href="/x" />} />`, or a function `(props, state) => …`. The part's attributes win over the caller's; handlers run the caller's first.
- Controlled: `value` with `onValueChange`. Uncontrolled: `defaultValue`.
- Works in React 18 and 19, on a server, and in StrictMode.
- No CSS is shipped and no styles are injected. A part is styled by its element, its `class`, and the attributes and CSS variables listed for it below.
- A boolean state is an attribute that is present or absent (`[data-open]`), never `="false"`.
- An entrance starts from `[data-starting-style]` and an exit ends at `[data-ending-style]`: write the hidden style under both and transition between. A part leaves the page when its own motion has ended.
- A popup is drawn in a portal at the end of `<body>` and placed by its `Positioner`, which carries `--anchor-width`, `--available-height`, `--transform-origin` and `data-side`.
- Every change callback is `(value, details)`: `details.reason`, `details.event`, `details.source` (mouse, touch, pen, keyboard, virtual, programmatic, agent), and `details.cancel()` to keep the value as it was.
- A value is controlled when it is given (`value`) and the component's own when it is not (`defaultValue`). `open`/`defaultOpen` and the others pair the same way.
- A control with a `name` is submitted with the form around it and follows the form's reset. Inside a `Field` it is the field's control.
- `PortalProvider` (`container`) says where the popups inside it are drawn, in place of the end of `<body>`: a shadow root's host, a full-screen element.
- An agent can read and use a page built with these: `createAgent()` from `@kirana-ui/core/agent` gives `snapshot()`, `act({ steps })` and `query()`; what it changes reaches the same callbacks with `details.source === "agent"`. Mark what needs a person with `data-agent-confirm`, what an agent must not see with `data-agent-hidden`, and a value it must not read with `data-agent-secret`.

## Components

### Accordion

```
import { Accordion } from "@kirana-ui/react/accordion"
```

Parts: `<Accordion.Root>`, `<Accordion.Item>`, `<Accordion.Header>`, `<Accordion.Trigger>`, `<Accordion.Panel>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: readonly Value[]`: The values of the open items.
- `defaultValue?: readonly Value[]`: Read once.
- `onValueChange?: ((value: Value[], details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `multiple?: boolean`: Whether several items can be open at once. Default `false`: opening one closes the others.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `orientation?: Orientation`: The way the arrows move between triggers. Default `vertical`.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows wrap from the last trigger to the first. Default `true`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the items.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the items are laid out, and the arrows that move between their triggers.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- item: One section: a header with its trigger, and a panel.
    - `data-open`: Present when the item is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- header: The heading that holds the trigger.
    - `data-open`: Present when the item is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- trigger: The button that opens and closes the item's panel.
    - `data-panel-open`: Present when the item's panel is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- panel: The item's content. In the page while open, and through its exit's motion.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: The way the items are laid out, and the arrows that move between their triggers.
    - `--accordion-panel-height`: The panel's content height while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open.
    - `--accordion-panel-width`: The panel's content width while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open.

### AlertDialog

```
import { AlertDialog } from "@kirana-ui/react/alert-dialog"
```

Parts: `<AlertDialog.Root>`, `<AlertDialog.Trigger>`, `<AlertDialog.Portal>`, `<AlertDialog.Backdrop>`, `<AlertDialog.Popup>`, `<AlertDialog.Title>`, `<AlertDialog.Description>`, `<AlertDialog.Close>`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the dialog.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the dialog is open.
- backdrop: The layer over the page behind the dialog.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
- popup: The dialog itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
    - `--nested-dialogs`: How many dialogs are open above this one.

### Autocomplete

```
import { Autocomplete } from "@kirana-ui/react/autocomplete"
```

Parts: `<Autocomplete.Root>`, `<Autocomplete.Input>`, `<Autocomplete.Trigger>`, `<Autocomplete.Clear>`, `<Autocomplete.Portal>`, `<Autocomplete.Positioner>`, `<Autocomplete.Popup>`, `<Autocomplete.Group>`, `<Autocomplete.GroupLabel>`, `<Autocomplete.Separator>`, `<Autocomplete.Item>`, `<Autocomplete.Empty>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: string`: What the input says: the text is the value.
- `defaultValue?: string`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: string, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `mode?: "list" | "none"`: `"list"` (the default): the suggestions are filtered by what is typed. `"none"`: they are as the caller draws them.
- `filter?: ((label: string, query: string) => boolean) | null`: Whether a suggestion is shown for what was typed; `null` shows every one.
- `openOnInputClick?: boolean`: Whether a press on the input opens the list. Default: it opens when something is typed.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `required?: boolean`
- `name?: string`: The input's name in the form around it.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `virtualized?: ListCollection`: Every row, when only some are in the page: each item is then given its `index`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- input: The text input: its text is the value, and what is typed asks for suggestions.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the list is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- trigger: A button that opens and closes the list.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the list is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- positioner: Places the list against the input. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The list of items.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-empty`: Present when no item is shown for what was typed.
- item: One suggestion: chosen, its text is written into the input.
    - `data-selected`: Present on the chosen item.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- clear: A button that empties the input and the value.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Autosize

```
import { Autosize } from "@kirana-ui/react/autosize"
```

Parts: `<Autosize.Textarea>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: unknown`: The text, when the caller holds it: a change that no key made (a form filled by code) is then measured too.

### Avatar

```
import { Avatar } from "@kirana-ui/react/avatar"
```

Parts: `<Avatar.Root>`, `<Avatar.Image>`, `<Avatar.Fallback>`.

### Button

```
import { Button } from "@kirana-ui/react/button"
```

Props:

- `disabled?: boolean`
- `focusableWhenDisabled?: boolean`: Keeps a disabled button in the tab order, so what it would do can still be read.
- `nativeButton?: boolean`: `false` when the element is not a `<button>`: it is given a button's role and keyboard.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The button.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Calendar

```
import { Calendar } from "@kirana-ui/react/calendar"
```

Parts: `<Calendar.Root>`, `<Calendar.Heading>`, `<Calendar.Previous>`, `<Calendar.Next>`, `<Calendar.Grid>`, `<Calendar.Weekdays>`, `<Calendar.HeadCell>`, `<Calendar.Weeks>`, `<Calendar.Cell>`, `<Calendar.Day>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: CalendarValue`: One day, or with `mode: "range"` a first and a last day; `null` for none.
- `defaultValue?: CalendarValue`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: CalendarValue, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `mode?: "single" | "range"`: Whether one day is chosen (the default) or a first and a last.
- `defaultFocusedValue?: IsoDate`: The day it opens on, when it has no value: its month is the one shown.
- `onMonthChange?: ((month: IsoDate) => void)`: Heard when another month is shown: its first day.
- `locale?: string`: The language and region its names, numbers, first day of the week and calendar follow (`"en-US"`, `"fa-IR"`). Give it: a server does not know the reader's.
- `calendarSystem?: CalendarSystem`: The calendar its months are laid out in, when it is not the Gregorian one: an instance from `@internationalized/date` (`new PersianCalendar()`). Given, not found from the locale: a page then carries only the calendars it uses.
- `min?: IsoDate`: The first and the last day that can be chosen.
- `max?: IsoDate`
- `isDateUnavailable?: ((date: IsoDate) => boolean)`: Days that cannot be chosen, though they can be reached: a day off, a day taken.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `readOnly?: boolean`
- `fixedWeeks?: boolean`: Always six rows, so the calendar is one height in every month.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The calendar.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
- previous: Shows the month before.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Shows the month after.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- cell: A day's cell.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, and on every day of a chosen range.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range.
- day: The button for a day.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, and on every day of a chosen range.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range.

### Carousel

```
import { Carousel } from "@kirana-ui/react/carousel"
```

Parts: `<Carousel.Root>`, `<Carousel.Viewport>`, `<Carousel.Item>`, `<Carousel.Previous>`, `<Carousel.Next>`, `<Carousel.Indicator>`.

Props of its root:

- `index?: number`: Which slide is at the start of the view, from 0.
- `defaultIndex?: number`
- `onIndexChange?: ((index: number, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the slides go across (the default) or down.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether going on from the last slide comes round to the first.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The carousel: a region, named by the caller.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the slides go across or down.
- viewport: What scrolls. The slides are its children; the design snaps them (`scroll-snap-type`) and says whether a step glides (`scroll-behavior`).
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the slides go across or down.
- item: One slide.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the slides go across or down.
    - `data-current`: Present on the slide the view is at, and on its button.
- previous: Goes back a slide.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Goes on a slide.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- indicator: A button for one slide.
    - `data-current`: Present on the slide the view is at, and on its button.

### Checkbox

```
import { Checkbox } from "@kirana-ui/react/checkbox"
```

Parts: `<Checkbox.Root>`, `<Checkbox.Indicator>`.

Props of its root:

- `checked?: boolean`
- `defaultChecked?: boolean`: Read once.
- `onCheckedChange?: ((checked: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `readOnly?: boolean`: Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required?: boolean`
- `name?: string`: With a name, the control is submitted with the form around it when it is checked.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `value?: string`: What is submitted. Default `"on"`, as a native checkbox's.
- `indeterminate?: boolean`: Neither checked nor unchecked: a parent of boxes that disagree.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The box. It holds a hidden native checkbox, which a form and a label reach.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present when it is neither checked nor unchecked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
- indicator: The mark. In the page while the box is checked or indeterminate.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present when it is neither checked nor unchecked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### Collapsible

```
import { Collapsible } from "@kirana-ui/react/collapsible"
```

Parts: `<Collapsible.Root>`, `<Collapsible.Trigger>`, `<Collapsible.Panel>`.

Props of its root:

- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`: Read once.
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `disabled?: boolean`

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the trigger and the panel.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- trigger: The button that opens and closes the panel.
    - `data-panel-open`: Present when the panel is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- panel: The content. In the page while open, and through its exit's motion.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `--collapsible-panel-height`: The panel's content height while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open.
    - `--collapsible-panel-width`: The panel's content width while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open.

### Combobox

```
import { Combobox } from "@kirana-ui/react/combobox"
```

Parts: `<Combobox.Root>`, `<Combobox.Input>`, `<Combobox.Trigger>`, `<Combobox.Clear>`, `<Combobox.Chips>`, `<Combobox.Chip>`, `<Combobox.ChipRemove>`, `<Combobox.Portal>`, `<Combobox.Positioner>`, `<Combobox.Popup>`, `<Combobox.Group>`, `<Combobox.GroupLabel>`, `<Combobox.Separator>`, `<Combobox.Item>`, `<Combobox.ItemIndicator>`, `<Combobox.Empty>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: Value | null`: The chosen value; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: Value | null`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: Value | null, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `inputValue?: string`: What the input says.
- `defaultInputValue?: string`
- `onInputValueChange?: ((value: string, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `name?: string`: With a name, the value is submitted with the form around it.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `items?: readonly { value: Value; label: string }[]`: The labels of the values, for the input to show a value before the list has ever been opened. Not needed for the list itself: its items are read from the markup.
- `filter?: ((label: string, query: string) => boolean) | null`: Whether an item is shown for what was typed. Default: its label holds the text, without regard to case. `null`: every item is shown, and the caller draws the ones it wants.
- `multiple?: boolean`: Several values, each shown as a chip beside the input: an item chosen is added, chosen again taken away, and the list stays open. The values are `values`, not `value`.
- `values?: readonly Value[]`
- `defaultValues?: readonly Value[]`
- `onValuesChange?: ((values: Value[], details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `required?: boolean`: In a field, "none" is then wrong.
- `inline?: boolean`: The list is always in the page, under the input, with no popup: a command palette. An item chosen is told to the caller, and the input keeps what was typed.
- `virtualized?: ListCollection`: Every row, when only some are in the page (a virtualizer draws the ones in view). The caller then filters: the collection is what is left, and each item is given its `index`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- input: The text input. What is typed filters the list, which is placed against it.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the list is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- trigger: A button that opens and closes the list.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the list is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- positioner: Places the list against the input. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The list of items.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-empty`: Present when no item is shown for what was typed.
- item: One choice in the list.
    - `data-selected`: Present on the chosen item.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- clear: A button that empties the input and the value.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- chipRemove: A chip's button that takes its value away.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Command

```
import { Command } from "@kirana-ui/react/command"
```

Parts: `<Command.Root>`, `<Command.Input>`, `<Command.List>`, `<Command.Empty>`, `<Command.Group>`, `<Command.GroupHeading>`, `<Command.Item>`, `<Command.Separator>`.

Props of its root:

- `inputValue?: string`: What the input says.
- `defaultInputValue?: string`
- `onInputValueChange?: ((value: string, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `onSelect?: ((value: string, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`: An item was chosen: pressed, or Enter while it was highlighted.
- `filter?: ((label: string, query: string, keywords: readonly string[]) => boolean) | null`: Whether an item is shown for what was typed. Default: its label or one of its keywords holds the text, without regard to case. `null`: every item is shown, and the caller draws the ones it wants.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether a step past an end of the list goes round to the other.
- `disabled?: boolean`

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: A list of commands with the input that filters it.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- input: The text input. What is typed filters the list; focus stays in it.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- list: The commands.
    - `data-empty`: Present when no item is shown for what was typed.
- item: One command.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### ContextMenu

```
import { ContextMenu } from "@kirana-ui/react/context-menu"
```

Parts: `<ContextMenu.Root>`, `<ContextMenu.Trigger>`, `<ContextMenu.Portal>`, `<ContextMenu.Positioner>`, `<ContextMenu.Popup>`, `<ContextMenu.Arrow>`, `<ContextMenu.Item>`, `<ContextMenu.LinkItem>`, `<ContextMenu.Group>`, `<ContextMenu.GroupLabel>`, `<ContextMenu.Separator>`, `<ContextMenu.CheckboxItem>`, `<ContextMenu.CheckboxItemIndicator>`, `<ContextMenu.RadioGroup>`, `<ContextMenu.RadioItem>`, `<ContextMenu.RadioItemIndicator>`, `<ContextMenu.SubmenuRoot>`, `<ContextMenu.SubmenuTrigger>`.

Props of its root:

- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `disabled?: boolean`: The trigger cannot be pressed; a submenu's is passed over.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do.
- `modal?: boolean`: Holds the page while the menu is open: its scroll is locked, and a press outside closes the menu and reaches nothing. Default: it does not. Not for a submenu.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The area a secondary press, or a long press on a touch screen, opens the menu in.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the menu is open.
- positioner: Places the menu against its trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The menu itself: the list of items.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the arrow cannot sit at the trigger's centre.
- item: An action. Choosing it closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- linkItem: An item that is a link. Choosing it follows the link and closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItem: An item that is checked or not. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItemIndicator: A mark a checkbox item shows while it is checked.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- radioGroup: Radio items of which one is chosen.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItem: One choice of a radio group. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItemIndicator: A mark a radio item shows while it is the chosen one.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- submenuTrigger: An item that opens a menu beside it.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when its menu is open.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### DateField

```
import { DateField } from "@kirana-ui/react/date-field"
```

Parts: `<DateField.Root>`, `<DateField.Segments>`, `<DateField.Segment>`, `<DateField.Input>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: IsoDate | null`: The day typed, once all of it is; `null` until then.
- `defaultValue?: IsoDate | null`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: IsoDate | null, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `locale?: string`: The language and region that order the day, the month and the year and put what stands between them (`"en-US"`: month/day/year). Give it: a server does not know the reader's.
- `min?: IsoDate`: The first and the last day it takes: outside them it says it is invalid.
- `max?: IsoDate`
- `placeholders?: Partial<Record<DateUnit, string>>`: What an empty part shows. Default: `dd`, `mm`, `yyyy`.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `readOnly?: boolean`
- `required?: boolean`
- `name?: string`: The name it is submitted under, by its hidden input.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form it belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The field: a group of the date's parts.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- segment: One piece of the date: a part that is typed, or what stands between two.
    - `data-segment="day | month | year | literal"`: Which piece it is.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present on a part that is empty.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.

### DatePicker

```
import { DatePicker } from "@kirana-ui/react/date-picker"
```

Parts: `<DatePicker.Root>`, `<DatePicker.Field>`, `<DatePicker.Segments>`, `<DatePicker.Segment>`, `<DatePicker.Input>`, `<DatePicker.Trigger>`, `<DatePicker.Portal>`, `<DatePicker.Positioner>`, `<DatePicker.Popup>`, `<DatePicker.Calendar>`, `<DatePicker.Heading>`, `<DatePicker.Previous>`, `<DatePicker.Next>`, `<DatePicker.Grid>`, `<DatePicker.Weekdays>`, `<DatePicker.HeadCell>`, `<DatePicker.Weeks>`, `<DatePicker.Cell>`, `<DatePicker.Day>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: IsoDate | null`: The day, typed or picked; `null` for none.
- `defaultValue?: IsoDate | null`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: IsoDate | null, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `locale?: string`: The language and region of the field and the calendar. Give it: a server does not know.
- `min?: IsoDate`: The first and the last day that can be typed or picked.
- `max?: IsoDate`
- `isDateUnavailable?: CalendarProps["isDateUnavailable"]`: Days that cannot be picked in the calendar.
- `calendarSystem?: CalendarProps["calendarSystem"]`: The calendar its months are laid out in, when it is not the Gregorian one.
- `fixedWeeks?: boolean`: Always six rows of days.
- `placeholders?: DateFieldProps["placeholders"]`: What an empty part of the field shows.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `readOnly?: boolean`
- `required?: boolean`
- `name?: string`: The name it is submitted under.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form it belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- field: The field: a group of the date's parts.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- segment: One piece of the date: a part that is typed, or what stands between two.
    - `data-segment="day | month | year | literal"`: Which piece it is.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present on a part that is empty.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- trigger: The button that opens the popover, and what it is placed against.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the popover is open.
- positioner: Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The popover itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
- calendar: The calendar.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
- previous: Shows the month before.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Shows the month after.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- cell: A day's cell.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, and on every day of a chosen range.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range.
- day: The button for a day.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, and on every day of a chosen range.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range.

### Dialog

import { Dialog } from "@kirana-ui/react/dialog"
```

Props of its root:

- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `modal?: boolean`: Blocks the page behind it and traps focus. Default `true`.
- `dismissible?: boolean`: Whether a press outside closes it. Default `true`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the dialog.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the dialog is open.
- backdrop: The layer over the page behind the dialog.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
- popup: The dialog itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
    - `--nested-dialogs`: How many dialogs are open above this one.

### Drawer

```
import { Drawer } from "@kirana-ui/react/drawer"
```

Parts: `<Drawer.Root>`, `<Drawer.Trigger>`, `<Drawer.Portal>`, `<Drawer.Backdrop>`, `<Drawer.Popup>`, `<Drawer.Title>`, `<Drawer.Description>`, `<Drawer.Close>`.

Props of its root:

- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `modal?: boolean`: Blocks the page behind it and traps focus. Default `true`.
- `dismissible?: boolean`: Whether a press outside closes it. Default `true`.
- `swipeDirection?: DrawerSide`: The way it is dragged to close it: the edge it came from. Default: `"down"`.
- `snapPoints?: readonly DrawerSnapPoint[]`: Places it rests at, each how much of itself shows: a share (`0.4`, or `"40%"`) or a length (`"148px"`, `"20rem"`). `[0.4, 1]` is a drawer that opens two fifths shown and is dragged up to the whole. Without any, it is whole.
- `snapPoint?: DrawerSnapPoint`: Which of them it rests at, as it was given.
- `defaultSnapPoint?: DrawerSnapPoint`: Where it opens. Default: the smallest.
- `onSnapPointChange?: ((snapPoint: DrawerSnapPoint, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the dialog.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the dialog is open.
- backdrop: The layer over the page behind the dialog.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-swiping`: Present while the drawer is dragged.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-x`: How far it has been dragged across.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-y`: How far it has been dragged up or down.
    - `--drawer-swipe-progress`: How far it has been dragged, of its own size: 0 to 1.
    - `--drawer-snap-point-offset`: How far from whole it rests, towards the edge it closes at: 0px at its largest snap point.
- popup: The drawer. A design moves it by what it says of the drag, and gives it `touch-action: none` where a finger drags it.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
    - `data-swiping`: Present while the drawer is dragged.
    - `data-swipe-direction="up | down | left | right"`: The way it is dragged to close it.
    - `data-swipe-dismiss`: Present once a drag has closed it.
    - `data-expanded`: Present while it rests whole, of several snap points.
    - `data-nested-drawer-open`: Present while another drawer is open over it.
    - `data-nested-drawer-swiping`: Present while a drawer over it is dragged.
    - `--nested-dialogs`: How many dialogs are open above this one.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-x`: How far it has been dragged across.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-y`: How far it has been dragged up or down.
    - `--drawer-swipe-progress`: How far it has been dragged, of its own size: 0 to 1.
    - `--drawer-snap-point-offset`: How far from whole it rests, towards the edge it closes at: 0px at its largest snap point.
    - `--drawer-height`: Its height.
    - `--nested-drawers`: How many drawers are open over it.
    - `--drawer-frontmost-height`: The height of the drawer in front of every other, while this one is open.
    - `--drawer-swipe-strength`: Once let go: 0.1 to 1, the share of the design's own time it should take to come to rest. A drawer thrown hard arrives sooner.
    - `--drawer-width`: Its width.

### Field

```
import { Field } from "@kirana-ui/react/field"
```

Parts: `<Field.Root>`, `<Field.Label>`, `<Field.Control>`, `<Field.Description>`, `<Field.Error>`, `<Field.Validity>`.

Props of its root:

- `name?: string`: The control's name in the form.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `invalid?: boolean`: Invalid whatever the value: an error known from elsewhere.
- `validate?: | (( value: string ) => string | readonly string[] | null | Promise<string | readonly string[] | null>)`: The field's own check, after the browser's: a message or several when the value is wrong, `null` when it is right. It may answer later, with a promise.
- `validationMode?: ValidationMode`: When the value is checked; the form's by default, else `"onSubmit"`.
- `validationDebounceTime?: number`: With `"onChange"`, how long the value must rest before it is checked, in milliseconds.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: A control with its label, its description and its errors.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- label: The control's name: a press on it reaches the control.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- control: The control: an input, a textarea or a select.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- description: More about the control, said after its name.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- error: What is wrong with the value. In the page while it applies.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### Fieldset

```
import { Fieldset } from "@kirana-ui/react/fieldset"
```

Parts: `<Fieldset.Root>`, `<Fieldset.Legend>`.

Props of its root:

- `disabled?: boolean`: Disables every field inside.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The group of fields.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- legend: The group's name.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Form

```
import { Form } from "@kirana-ui/react/form"
```

Props:

- `errors?: FormErrors`: Errors from outside the page (a server's), by field name. A field shows its own until its value changes.
- `onClearErrors?: ((errors: FormErrors) => void)`: A field's value changed while it showed an error from `errors`: what is left of them.
- `onFormSubmit?: ((values: FormValues, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`: Every field is valid. Given this, the page is not left: the values come as an object. Without it, the form submits as a form does.
- `validationMode?: ValidationMode`: When the form's fields check their values, unless a field says otherwise. Default `"onSubmit"`.

### HoverCard

```
import { HoverCard } from "@kirana-ui/react/hover-card"
```

Parts: `<HoverCard.Root>`, `<HoverCard.Trigger>`, `<HoverCard.Portal>`, `<HoverCard.Positioner>`, `<HoverCard.Popup>`, `<HoverCard.Arrow>`.

Props of its root:

- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `delay?: number`: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the popup opens, in milliseconds.
- `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves the popup closes, in milliseconds.
- `disabled?: boolean`

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The link the card previews.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the card is open.
- positioner: Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The card itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-instant="delay | focus | dismiss"`: Present when it opened or closed without its usual wait, for a design that skips the motion then.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger, placed along the popup's edge.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the popup was pushed along its edge, so the arrow is not at the trigger's centre.

### Listbox

```
import { Listbox } from "@kirana-ui/react/listbox"
```

Parts: `<Listbox.Root>`, `<Listbox.Item>`, `<Listbox.ItemIndicator>`, `<Listbox.Group>`, `<Listbox.GroupLabel>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: readonly Value[]`: The chosen values: none, one, or with `multiple` several.
- `defaultValue?: readonly Value[]`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: Value[], details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `multiple?: boolean`: Whether more than one can be chosen: a press then adds or takes away.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do not.
- `name?: string`: With a name, the chosen values are submitted with the form around the list.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the list belongs to, when it is not inside it.
- `virtualized?: ListCollection`: Every row, when only some are in the page (a virtualizer draws the ones in view): how many there are, their names, and how to bring one into the page. Each item is then given its `index`.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The list. It is one stop for Tab.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- item: One choice in the list.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen item.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- itemIndicator: A mark an item shows while it is chosen.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen item.

### Menu

```
import { Menu } from "@kirana-ui/react/menu"
```

Parts: `<Menu.Root>`, `<Menu.Trigger>`, `<Menu.Portal>`, `<Menu.Positioner>`, `<Menu.Popup>`, `<Menu.Arrow>`, `<Menu.Item>`, `<Menu.LinkItem>`, `<Menu.Group>`, `<Menu.GroupLabel>`, `<Menu.Separator>`, `<Menu.CheckboxItem>`, `<Menu.CheckboxItemIndicator>`, `<Menu.RadioGroup>`, `<Menu.RadioItem>`, `<Menu.RadioItemIndicator>`, `<Menu.SubmenuRoot>`, `<Menu.SubmenuTrigger>`.

Props of its root:

- `open?: boolean`
- `defaultOpen?: boolean`
- `onOpenChange?: ((open: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `disabled?: boolean`: The trigger cannot be pressed; a submenu's is passed over.
- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last item to the first. Default: they do.
- `modal?: boolean`: Holds the page while the menu is open: its scroll is locked, and a press outside closes the menu and reaches nothing. Default: it does not. Not for a submenu.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the menu, and what it is placed against.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the menu is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- positioner: Places the menu against its trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
- popup: The menu itself: the list of items.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the arrow cannot sit at the trigger's centre.
- item: An action. Choosing it closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- linkItem: An item that is a link. Choosing it follows the link and closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItem: An item that is checked or not. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItemIndicator: A mark a checkbox item shows while it is checked.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- radioGroup: Radio items of which one is chosen.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItem: One choice of a radio group. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItemIndicator: A mark a radio item shows while it is the chosen one.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- submenuTrigger: An item that opens a menu beside it.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when its menu is open.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Menubar

```
import { Menubar } from "@kirana-ui/react/menubar"
```

Props:

- `loop?: boolean`: Whether the arrows go round from the last menu to the first. Default: they do.
- `disabled?: boolean`: No menu of the bar opens.
- `orientation?: Orientation`: A row (the default) or a column of menus. In a column a menu opens beside its trigger.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The row of menus. A menu inside it is one of its items.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether its menus are in a row or a column.

### MessageScroller

```
import { MessageScroller } from "@kirana-ui/react/message-scroller"
```

Parts: `<MessageScroller.Root>`, `<MessageScroller.Viewport>`, `<MessageScroller.Content>`, `<MessageScroller.Button>`.

Props of its root:

- `initial?: "bottom" | "top"`: Where it begins: at the newest message (the default), or at the first.
- `threshold?: number`: How near the end counts as at it, in pixels. Default: 24.
- `onAtBottomChange?: ((atBottom: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`: Heard when it comes to the end or leaves it.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: What holds the conversation and its button.
    - `data-at-bottom`: Present while the newest message is in view.
- viewport: What scrolls: a log, reached by the keyboard.
    - `data-at-bottom`: Present while the newest message is in view.
- button: Goes to the newest message. Inert while that is in view.
    - `data-at-bottom`: Present while the newest message is in view.

### NavigationMenu

```
import { NavigationMenu } from "@kirana-ui/react/navigation-menu"
```

Parts: `<NavigationMenu.Root>`, `<NavigationMenu.List>`, `<NavigationMenu.Item>`, `<NavigationMenu.Trigger>`, `<NavigationMenu.Icon>`, `<NavigationMenu.Content>`, `<NavigationMenu.Link>`, `<NavigationMenu.Portal>`, `<NavigationMenu.Positioner>`, `<NavigationMenu.Popup>`, `<NavigationMenu.Viewport>`, `<NavigationMenu.Arrow>`, `<NavigationMenu.Backdrop>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: Value | null`: The item whose content is shown; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: Value | null`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: Value | null, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `delay?: number`: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before its content shows, in milliseconds.
- `closeDelay?: number`: How long after the pointer leaves the content goes, in milliseconds.
- `orientation?: Orientation`

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The navigation.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the list is a row or a column.
- list: The row of items.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the list is a row or a column.
- trigger: The button that shows an item's content.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present while the item's content is shown.
- icon: A mark on a trigger that shows whether its content is open.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present while the item's content is shown.
- content: What an item shows. It is drawn in the viewport every item shares.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-activation-direction="left | right"`: Which way it came from: the item before it, or after.
- link: A link, in the list or in an item's content.
    - `data-active`: Present on the link of the page the reader is on.
- positioner: Places the popup against the open item's trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
    - `--positioner-width`: The open content's width.
    - `--positioner-height`: The open content's height.
- popup: The panel every item's content is shown in.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `--popup-width`: The open content's width.
    - `--popup-height`: The open content's height.
- arrow: An element that points at the open item's trigger.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the arrow cannot sit at the trigger's centre.
- backdrop: An element behind the popup, for a design that dims the page.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### NumberField

```
import { NumberField } from "@kirana-ui/react/number-field"
```

Parts: `<NumberField.Root>`, `<NumberField.Group>`, `<NumberField.Input>`, `<NumberField.Increment>`, `<NumberField.Decrement>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: number | null`: The number; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: number | null`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: number | null, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `onValueCommitted?: ((value: number | null, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`: Heard once a change is done: focus left the input, a key or a button stepped it.
- `min?: number`
- `max?: number`
- `step?: number`: What the buttons and the arrows move by. Default 1.
- `smallStep?: number`: With Alt held. Default 0.1.
- `largeStep?: number`: With Shift held. Default 10.
- `snapOnStep?: boolean`: A step lands on a multiple of the step, counted from `min`.
- `allowWheelScrub?: boolean`: The wheel steps it while the pointer is over the input and focus is in it.
- `format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions`: How the number is written.
- `locale?: string`: The language it is written in; the page's by default.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `readOnly?: boolean`
- `required?: boolean`
- `name?: string`: With a name, the number is submitted with the form around it.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the number field's parts.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- group: What holds the input and its buttons, as one control.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- input: The text input: it takes what its locale writes a number with.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- increment: A button that steps the number up. Held, it goes on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.
- decrement: A button that steps the number down. Held, it goes on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when the number cannot be changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when a number must be given.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the number is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while there is a number.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the number was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the number is wrong.

### Otp

```
import { Otp } from "@kirana-ui/react/otp"
```

Parts: `<Otp.Root>`, `<Otp.Input>`, `<Otp.Group>`, `<Otp.Slot>`, `<Otp.Separator>`, `<Otp.Caret>`.

Props of its root:

- `length?: number`: How many characters the code has. Default: 6.
- `value?: string`
- `defaultValue?: string`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: string, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`
- `onComplete?: ((value: string) => void)`: Every character is in: the moment to send the code.
- `mode?: "numeric" | "alphanumeric" | "text"`: What a character may be. Default: `numeric`.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `name?: string`: With a name, the code is submitted with the form around it.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the input belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The code: the input and its cells.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-complete`: Present when every character is in.
- input: The one input the code is typed in. A design lays it over the cells, unseen.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- slot: One cell of the code.
    - `data-index`: The cell's place, from 0.
    - `data-active`: Present on the cell the next character goes in, or that is selected.
    - `data-filled`: Present when the cell has its character.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

- `pageSize?: number`: How many items a page holds. Default 10.

    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- previous: Goes to the page before.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Goes to the page after.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### Progress

```
import { Progress } from "@kirana-ui/react/progress"
```

Parts: `<Progress.Root>`, `<Progress.Track>`, `<Progress.Indicator>`, `<Progress.Value>`, `<Progress.Label>`.

Props of its root:

- `value: number | null`: The value. For a progress bar, `null` is "under way, how far is not known".
- `min?: number`: Default 0.
- `max?: number`: Default 100.
- `format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions`: How the value is written; a percentage of the range by default.
- `locale?: string`: The language the value is written in; the page's by default.
- `getAriaValueText?: ((text: string | undefined, value: number | null) => string)`: What assistive technology reads for the value, when the written value is not enough.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The progress bar: it says the value to assistive technology.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.
- track: The whole range.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.
- indicator: The filled part: its width is the value's share of the range.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.
- value: The value, written.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.
- label: The bar's name.
    - `data-progressing`: Present while the task is under way.
    - `data-complete`: Present once the value has reached the end of the range.
    - `data-indeterminate`: Present while how far the task has come is not known.

### RadioGroup

```
import { RadioGroup } from "@kirana-ui/react/radio-group"
```

Parts: `<RadioGroup.Root>`, `<RadioGroup.Item>`, `<RadioGroup.Indicator>`.

Props of its root:

- `value?: Value | null`: The chosen value; `null` is "none".
- `defaultValue?: Value | null`
- `onValueChange?: ((value: Value | null, details: ChangeDetails) => void)`: `null` only when a form's reset takes the group back to "none".
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `readOnly?: boolean`
- `required?: boolean`
- `name?: string`: With a name, the chosen value is submitted with the form around the group.
- `form?: string`: The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Groups the items: one of them is chosen at most.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
- item: One choice. It holds a hidden native radio, which a form and a label reach.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
- indicator: The mark. In the page while its item is the chosen one.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it can be read but not changed.
    - `data-required`: Present when the form needs it.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### Resizable

```
import { Resizable } from "@kirana-ui/react/resizable"
```

Parts: `<Resizable.Group>`, `<Resizable.Panel>`, `<Resizable.Handle>`.

Props of its root:

- `orientation?: Orientation`: Whether the panels are side by side (the default) or one over the other.
- `onSizesChange?: ((sizes: number[], details: ChangeDetails) => void)`: Heard as the panels are resized: each panel's share, in the page's order, summing to 100.
- `keyboardStep?: number`: How far an arrow key moves a handle, in hundredths of the group. Default: 10.
- `disabled?: boolean`

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- group: The panels and the bars between them. A design lays it out as a flex box.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- panel: One panel. It carries its share of the group.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other.
    - `--panel-size`: The panel's share, in hundredths of the group.
- handle: The bar between two panels: dragged, or moved with the arrows.
    - `data-orientation="horizontal | vertical"`: Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while the bar is dragged.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### ScrollArea

import { ScrollArea } from "@kirana-ui/react/scroll-area"
```

Parts: `<ScrollArea.Root>`, `<ScrollArea.Viewport>`, `<ScrollArea.Content>`, `<ScrollArea.Scrollbar>`, `<ScrollArea.Thumb>`, `<ScrollArea.Corner>`.
